segments.text: IT is past ten, or I would write you a long letter. Our convoy is come, and perhaps we may sail to-morrow. It is delightful to be here. We come from Dock in the evenings, in great companies, singing and praising GOD. Our parting there has been more awful than words can express. I shall have sailed before you can answer this.

Eternal JESUS, bless thy word,
Be mindful of thy child;
Behold thy servant; be thou, LORD,
His helmet, sword, and shield.

Close by thy side him ever keep;
Still hold him in thy hand,
Till he and all thy ransom’d sheep,
Shall rest in their own land.
